_provenance: A multi-tradition decans compilation (found online; original compiler unattributed): Liber Hermetis, Sacred Book of Hermes (names/descriptions/stones/plants), Ptolemaic & Ostanes & Firmicus Maternus decan-gods, Testament of Solomon spirits/invocations/thwarting-angels. Decan numbering follows the Liber Hermetis order (1 = Cancer 1). Bounds are fixed tropical 10-degree thirds (decans do NOT precess in this division). Planetary (Chaldean face) ruler computed separately in dignities.py / stars.py.

Cancer 1.Liber Hermetis Description: It has the form of a serpent joined with the face of a dog. In the tail however a heart like a pine (cone?). It has half of its tailed turned down and from either part of the side of the heart slender serpents above the dog’s head. This image much analogy, which we will attempt to solve.
Cancer 1.Sacred Book Description: It has the face of a dog and the body of a coiled snake, set upon a pedestal. It regulates conditions of the flanks.
Cancer 1.Sacred Book: Stones: Dryite/found at the root of trees
Cancer 1.ToS Invocation (TCM): "I am Metathiax and I cause kidney pains. If I hear 'Adonael, constrain Metathiax,' I flee immediately through the air."

Cancer 2.Liber Hermetis Description: It has the body of a vulture, but the face of Isis.  IT is the bearing the winged queen’s crown.  It is erect on two feet (with) greaves having wings.
Cancer 2.Sacred Book Description: The form of a woman with the body of a bird, wings outstretched as if to fly, with a braided basket on her head. She regulates conditions of the lungs.
Cancer 2.ToS Invocation (TCM): "I am called Katanikotael. I send disputes and litigations into houses. If someone wants to reestablish the peace, write upon seven leaves of laurel the names which disarm me: 'Angel, Eae, Ieo, Sabaoth, constrain Katanikotael!' You must first wash the leaves and then asperge this holy water in the house, and I disappear immediately."

Cancer 3.Liber Hermetis Description: In its representation it has two round heads the right….and the left one of Anubis…namely the waxen images of the Moon and Juno.  In the middle between the two goddesses is a dragon having four heads.  Two of its heads are held aloft and two are bent this way and that towards a pine (tree?).  They are rather bigger indeed than she (is).
Cancer 3.Sacred Book Description: Two women's faces looking in opposite directions, one wears a little headdress, the other a diadem. Her throat has a necklace of dragons. This bust is set upon a pedestal. She governs the spleen.
Cancer 3.ToS Invocation (TCM): "My name is Saphorael. I send discords to men and I rejoice every time I irritate them. If someone writes 'Iae Ieo, sons of Sabaoth' and carries these names on their neck, I disappear immediately."

Leo 1.Liber Hermetis Description: It is a great serpent with the form of a lion having solar rays encircling its head.
Leo 1.Sacred Book Description: The head of a lion atop the body of a coiled snake, looking skyward and surrounded by solar rays. He governs afflictions of the heart.
Leo 1.ToS Invocation (TCM): "I am Phobothel. I loosen the tendons. If I hear 'Adonai' I flee through the field immediately."

Leo 2.Sacred Book Description: A naked man carrying a sceptre in his right hand and a whip in his left, with a lunar crescent on his head. He governs afflictions of the shoulder blades.
Leo 2.ToS Invocation (TCM): "I am called Leroel. I bring chill, shivers and stomach pains. If I hear 'Iax, get out! Do not be heated, because Solomon is more powerful than the eleven patriarchs!' I disappear immediately."

Leo 3.Liber Hermetis Description: It is a man with the likeness of a crocodile.
Leo 3.Sacred Book Description: A man with a predator's head (crocodile presumably), he holds his right hand high in greeting and carries a vial in his left. He rules diseases of the liver.
Leo 3.ToS Invocation (TCM): "I am called Soubelti. I send feverish chills and the numbness. If I hear 'Rizhoel, constrain Soubelti!' I flee immediately to the clouds."

Virgo 1.Liber Hermetis Description: It is a serpent put together awry.  Its head is the likeness of the Moon.
Virgo 1.Sacred Book Description: A dog's head wearing a great crown. The rest of the body is hot/burning and stands on a pedestal. (Probably a snake body.) It governs afflictions of the stomach.
Virgo 1.ToS Invocation (TCM): "I am called Katrax. I inflict to men incurable fevers. Whoever wants to heal must smash coriander, and anoint the lips with the juice, saying: 'By Dan, I conjure you! Flee from that image of God!' and I disappear immediately."

Virgo 2.Liber Hermetis Description: It is a man standing, girded below from the waist all the way to the hollows of his feet, having four wings- two turned back and two on his breast.  It has four Ibis heads having an iron beak.
Virgo 2.Sacred Book Description: The head of a horned goat on a mummified body, holding a sceptre in his right hand and a (canopic?) jar in his left. It regulates conditions of the bowels.
Virgo 2.ToS Invocation (TCM): "I am called Ieropa. I seat myself upon the belly of men and I cause convulsions when they bathe. If I meet a man on my way, with one strike I make him fall down. Whoever says three times in the right ear of the patient 'Iouda, Zizabou' forces me to go away."

Virgo 3.Liber Hermetis Description: It is like a mummy, its whole body is like one who has been buried.
Virgo 3.Sacred Book Description: A woman, mummified from her breasts to her feet, carrying a sceptre with both hands and wearing a small headdress. She governs conditions of the navel.
Virgo 3.ToS Invocation (TCM): "I am Modebel. I separate man from his wife. If someone writes the names of the eight patriarchs and puts the paper in the doorway, I disappear immediately."

Libra 1.Liber Hermetis Description: There are two images, erect, having scorpions under their feet.  Their hands are hanging down to their thighs.  In their rights they are holding two water jugs, in the middle of which there are two fine pipes through which water is poured out. There are regal things on their heads.
Libra 1.Sacred Book Description: An old man wearing a belt, his left hand raised high as if to receive something, his right hand, carrying a vial, hanging low. It regulates conditions of the fundament. (The general ass area?)
Libra 1.ToS Invocation (TCM): "I am called Mardero. I bring incurable fevers shivering, but I flee immediately from the house in which you write my name."

Libra 2.Liber Hermetis Description: In the figure, however, it is a certain man, standing over a marsh, leaving off into one with feet joined, completely girded from the breasts all the way to the hollows of the feet in variegated linen, having his head shaven leaving one spot where there is hair.
Libra 2.Sacred Book Description: He stands on a fountain where two streams meet as one. He is bandaged from the breast to his feet, he has a thick, curly beard and holds a jar in one hand. He governs the urethra, bladder and urinary tract.
Libra 2.ToS Invocation (TCM): "My name is Rhyx Nathotho. I sit over the knees of men. If someone writes 'Phounebiel' on a leaf, I disappear without delay."

Libra 3.Liber Hermetis Description: It is in the appearance of a serpent.
Libra 3.Sacred Book Description: Snake headed, set with a great crown, wearing a tight garment. It regulates conditions of the anus, haemorrhoids, calluses and sores.
Libra 3.ToS Invocation (TCM): "I am Rhyx Alath. I bring asthma to small children. If someone writes 'Rarideris' and carries it, I disappear immediately."

Scorpio 1.Liber Hermetis Description: It is in the form of a crab having wings. It is girt in linen from the breast all the way to the hollows of the feet.
Scorpio 1.Sacred Book Description: Bull-headed, with four wings, girdled with a belt, holding a sceptre in his left hand and a vial in his right. He governs pain at the opening of the penis, ulcers and inflammations.
Scorpio 1.ToS Invocation (TCM): "I am called Rhy Audameooth. I send the cardiac diseases. If someone writes 'Raiouoth', I disappear immediately."

Scorpio 2.Liber Hermetis Description: It is a man standing with his feet joined on the back of a scorpion, holding a great serpent with both feet on either side of his breast.
Scorpio 2.Sacred Book Description: Feet together, wearing a stole and standing upon a scorpion. It (he?) governs genitals, growths and warts.
Scorpio 2.ToS Invocation (TCM): "I am called Rhyx Manthado and I cause kidney pains. I disappear immediately if someone writes 'Iaoth, Ouriel'."

Scorpio 3.Liber Hermetis Description: It has a human body and the form of a he-goat, holding eggs hanging from a thread in both hands.
Scorpio 3.Sacred Book Description: Goat-headed and bandaged from breast to heels, he has both hands upon a rudder. He governs the testicles and inflammation in one or both.
Scorpio 3.ToS Invocation (TCM): "My name is Rhyx Aktonme. I cause pain in the ribs. If one writes upon wood of a wrecked ship 'Marmaraoth of the air', I at once retreat."

Sagittarius 1.Liber Hermetis Description: It is a man having the head of a dog, extending his left hand to the lower part, he holds something sharp. It is however a small weapon with points. He is girt with variegated net all the way to his thighs.
Sagittarius 1.Sacred Book Description: He is wrapped in colourful bandages from his breast to his heels, his head is also bound. His left hand is lowered and covered by his garments, he holds an arrow in his right hand. He governs the thigh tumours called buboes.
Sagittarius 1.ToS Invocation (TCM): "I am Rhyx Anatreth. I send fevers and convulsions in the entrails. I disappear immediately when I hear 'Arara, Arare.' "

Sagittarius 2.Liber Hermetis Description: This (image) stands on a place that is slippery and sloping downward.  He has the face of a weasel, bu the body of a man.
Sagittarius 2.Sacred Book Description: A man with a weasel's face, a flask in his right hand, a sceptre in his left. He stands on a steep bank. He regulates bone setting.
Sagittarius 2.ToS Invocation (TCM): "I am called Rhyx the Enautha. I make absent the senses and change hearts. If someone writes 'Kalazael,' I disappear immediately."

Sagittarius 3.Sacred Book Description: An old man, bandaged from breast to heels, wearing a great crown. He carries a flask in his right hand and a sceptre in his left. He governs the thighs and sends them pain and ulceration
Sagittarius 3.ToS Invocation (TCM): "I call myself Rhyx Axesbuth. I cause to men diseases of the chest and haemorrhoids. If someone conjure me through wine which is given to the diseased to drink, I disappear immediately."

Capricorn 1.Liber Hermetis Description: It is a certain man without a head. He holds his own head with his right hand, in his left a sword.
Capricorn 1.Sacred Book Description: A headless man with a scarab girt around his chest with a leather band. He carries a vial in his right hand, his left rests upon his thigh. He governs the knees and their complaints.
Capricorn 1.ToS Invocation (TCM): "My name is Rhyx Hapax. I prevent people from sleeping. If someone writes 'Kok Phedismos' and if these words are attached to the temples, I disappear immediately."

Capricorn 2.Liber Hermetis Description: It hs the face of a bull on the body of a man dressed with the skin of a scarab.
Capricorn 2.Sacred Book Description: The head of a pig, with a body similar to that of the first decan, wearing a belt, carrying a vial in his right hand and a sword in his left. It regulates the elbows.
Capricorn 2.ToS Invocation (TCM): "I am Rhyx Anoster. I send the hysteric condition and painful swellings of the bladder. If someone crushes three laurel seeds in virgin oil and anoints the body saying: 'I conjure thee by Marmaraoth', I disappear immediately."

Capricorn 3.Sacred Book Description: A man wearing a mask and a girdle, holding a vial in his right hand and an arrow in his left. He governs the same as the second Capricorn decan.
Capricorn 3.ToS Invocation (TCM): "I am Rhyx Physikoreth. I provoke long diseases. If someone puts salt in oil and anoints the sick saying: 'Cherubim, Seraphim, help him', I disappear immediately."

Aquarius 1.Liber Hermetis Description: It is of human appearance having the face of a dog, girt from the breasts all the way to the hollows of the foot.
Aquarius 1.Sacred Book Description: A dog's head on a body bandaged from the breast to the heels. He governs the shins and causes abscesses and ulcers there.
Aquarius 1.ToS Invocation (TCM): "I call myself Rhyx Aleureth. If anyone swallows the bone of a fish, I will disappear if someone put a bone of the same fish upon the chest of a sick person."

Aquarius 2.Sacred Book Description: A man bandaged from the breast to the heels, wearing a great crown and carrying an Ankh. He governs knees and calves.
Aquarius 2.ToS Invocation (TCM): "I am Rhyx Ichthyon. I detach tendons. If I hear 'Adonai, malthe', I disappear immediately."

Aquarius 3.Sacred Book Description: A man bandaged from chest to ankles, wearing a great crown. He carries a jar in his right hand and a sceptre in his left. He also governs knees and calves.
Aquarius 3.ToS Invocation (TCM): "I am called Rhyx Achoneoth. I cause pains in the throat and in the tonsils. If someone writes 'Leikourgos' [diminishing letter by letter], on the leaves of ivy, I flee."

Pisces 1.Liber Hermetis Description: It is a man dressed in dark clothes having his own face. He is girt with a belt simply.
Pisces 1.Sacred Book Description: A man bandaged from chest to heels, robed in indigo, holding a vial in his right hand and resting his left hand on his thigh. He governs the feet and sends them abscesses.
Pisces 1.ToS Invocation (TCM): "My name is Rhyx Autoth. I arouse envy and quarrel between friends. If someone writes the alpha and the beta I am defeated."

Pisces 2.Sacred Book Description: A man, naked but wearing a cape thrown back over his shoulders and a great crown. He holds a vial in his right hand and holds his left index finger to his lips. He also governs the feet.
Pisces 2.ToS Invocation (TCM): "I am Rhyx Phtheneooth. I cast evil eye on all men. The eye much-suffering, inscribed, renders me unable to do hard."

Pisces 3.Sacred Book Description: A black, sinuous dragon with a beard and a great crown on his head. He governs the feet.
Pisces 3.ToS Invocation (TCM): "I am called Rhyx Mianeth. I am enemy of the body. I ruin houses and waste flesh. If someone writes 'Melto, Ardad, Anaath' in the hall of the house, I flee from the place."

Aries 1.Liber Hermetis Description: It is an armed sign, standing, upright, walking, having the likeness of a man, standing on feet like claws, and holding above his head a double-sided battle-axe with both hands.
Aries 1.Sacred Book Description: The face of a little child, his hands raised up, holding a sceptre above his head. He dominates the affections of the head.
Aries 1.ToS Invocation (TCM): "I am the first face of the zodiac; my name is Rhyax. I cause ills of the head to men and beat their brows. If I hear 'Michael constrains Rhyax', I flee on high."

Aries 2.Liber Hermetis Description: It has a two headed face and a lotus of the kings open on its head.  In the compass of the lotus there re stars the splendor of gold. He has also in his right hand a water jug that is called life, in his left a scepter the extremity of which is bifurcated.  This decan is clothed in linen and he treads under both his feet a tortoise entirely covered with a net.
Aries 2.Sacred Book Description: Has a dog's face, holds a sceptre in his right hand, a disk in his left and is wrapped with strips to the heels. (Mummified?) He governs the nostrils and all conditions thereof.
Aries 2.ToS Invocation (TCM): "I am called Barsaphael. I cause pain on one side of the head of men who lie down at my hour. When I hear 'Gabriel constrains Barsaphael' I escape immediately to the heights."

Aries 3.Liber Hermetis Description: It is like a woman, erect, adorned with linen tied with gold strings tinted a dark rose colour.  She has a royal gold (crown) on her head.  In the middle of her belly there are belly emeralds.  She is holding a four-headed serpent on top of the staff.  The two heads in the middle are to one side and the (other) to are to the opposite side.
Aries 3.Sacred Book Description: A woman with a disk on her head, in her right hand a sceptre, in her left a water vessel, wrapped with bandages to her heels. She governs the ear, uvula and teeth.
Aries 3.ToS Invocation (TCM): "I am called Artosael. I cause violent pain in the eyes. But if I hear 'Uriel constrains Arostael!' I flee on high."

Taurus 1.Liber Hermetis Description: It has the whole body of the buried Osiris, adorned with gold and dark tie-strings.  It has the head of a bull and a queen’s crown and two elephant’s trunks.  In the middle of the horns stands the goddess herself.
Taurus 1.Sacred Book Description: Has a ram's head, is dressed as Osiris down to the feet, both hands hold sceptres which rest on his shoulders. Governs the neck.
Taurus 1.ToS Invocation (TCM): "I am called Horopel and I send boils, inflammation of the muscles of the throat and abscesses. When I hear 'Raphael constrains Horopel!' I escape toward the heights."

Taurus 2.Liber Hermetis Description: Its image is a man, erect, having tightly curled hair on both sides of his head.  On his chin there is a growing of fine hairs (and) on his face there is a beard hanging down to his neck from both parts of his chin.
Taurus 2.Sacred Book Description: A woman holding a sceptre in both hands, covered in bandages down to her feet, like Osiris. She governs the tonsils and the neck.
Taurus 2.ToS Invocation (TCM): "My name is Kairoxanondalon. I bite the ears. When I hear 'Ourouel, constrain Kairoxanondalon,' I flee through the air."

Taurus 3.Liber Hermetis Description: It is standing like Saturn with his feet together adorned with rose-coloured armor. All of its body is human but its head is that of a pig.
Taurus 3.Sacred Book Description: A dog-headed man with a disk on his head, he holds a sceptre in his right hand while his left is lowered behind him. His belt hangs down to his knees. He governs the mouth and throat.
Taurus 3.ToS Invocation (TCM): "I am called Sphendonael. I cause parotid tumours, and tetanic recurvation. If I hear 'Sabael, constrain Sphendonael,' I flee to the heights."

Gemini 1.Liber Hermetis Description: It is an armed man having an ass’s face, holding a sword in his right hand.
Gemini 1.Sacred Book Description: A man with an ass's face, carrying a small key in his right hand, with his left hand hanging, wearing a pleated garment to the knee. (Roman military wear?) He rules the tops of shoulders.
Gemini 1.ToS Invocation (TCM): "I am called Sphandor. I weaken the force of the shoulders and paralyse the tendons of the hands and paralyse the members. If I hear 'Arael constrain Sphandor' I flee immediatly to the clouds."

Gemini 2.Liber Hermetis Description: It has a double face.  It is walking.  It is armed.  In its left hand it is holding a bow and arrows and with both its feet it treads upon hares.
Gemini 2.Sacred Book Description: A goat-faced man, holding a stick in his right hand, with his left hand on his thigh, wearing pleated garments down to the knee. He governs the arms.
Gemini 2.ToS Invocation (TCM): "My name is Belbel. I twist the heart and the minds of men. If I hear 'Karael, constrain Belbel,' I flee immediately through the air."

Gemini 3.Liber Hermetis Description: It has the beautiful face of Isis, having hair moves every which way.
Gemini 3.Sacred Book Description: A woman holding lightning in her right hand and a vial in her left. She is winged and wears a great crown on her head.
Gemini 3.ToS Invocation (TCM): "I am called Kourtael. I send colics into the bowels. If I hear 'Iaoth, constrain Kourtael,' I flee immediately to the clouds."
